description: This circular walk in Wokingham visits two of the local walking attractions to the south of the town. On the walk you will first enjoy the peaceful woodland trails in Gorrick Woods before heading to the pretty Heath Lake Nature Reserve. The reserve is a Site of Special Scientific Interest and includes a photogenic lake surrounded by coniferous woodland. You can also look out for lots of birds on the water here.To continue your walking in the area pick up theWokingham Wayto explore the wider area around the town. You could also visitCrowthornewhich is located very close to the southern end of the walk.
